Devourer Tentacles are a [[:Category:Drops|Drop]] that most likely will be expanded upon as [[:Category:Drops#Materials|Materials]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==

* Dropped by [[Primitive Devourer|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Devourer|Adapted Devourers]].
* Found in [[Parasitic Growth Block|Malignant Growths]].

== ''Usage'' ==
{{CraftingTable|r1_b1=Bolster Husk|r1_a2=Devourer Tentacle|r1_b2=Module Genic Receptacle|r1_c2=Arachnida Claw|r1_b3=Longarms Armor Fragment|r1_output=Adapted Module|r1_count=1}}

== Trivia ==
* The Devourer Tentacle is colored in a dull turquoise color, standing in opposition to the [[Primitive Devourer]] which is colored pale. It is noteworthy, however, that the [[Adapted Devourer]] shares the color of the Tentacle.
